title: Steelers’ Joey Porter Jr. doesn’t close door on sitting out Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers’ Joey Porter Jr. doesn’t close door on sitting out Week 1
sources.description: Three players from the Steelers’ 2023 draft class received big-money extensions from the team this offseason. Not among that group was arguably the best player in that Pittsburgh draft class: cornerback Joey Porter Jr., who didn’t practice over the summer while on the Physically Unable to Perform list with a reported back injury — and […]
